messages:
Elena (CEO): Quick company update: Marcus Vega is stepping into a new role as Head of Distributed Systems, reporting to me, effective June 1. Hell lead cross-team work on sharding, routing policies, and multi-region fallbacks. This creates an Eng Lead (Serving) opening we want to prioritize internally for one week. Details below.

Marcus Vega: Really excited to take this on. My immediate focus will be reducing cross-region latencies and formalizing the fallback policy. Ill be hands-on for the first month to set priorities.

Maya (People Ops): Internal application window for Eng Lead - Serving (L4) opens now and runs through Apr 12. Were asking for one-line notes on relevant sharding/rollout experience. Hiring panel will include Engineering, SRE, and Product.

Hiro Tanaka: For clarity 
 will the Eng Lead role remain in the serving org or move under Marcus? Need to know squad reporting for sprint planning.

Elena (CEO): Eng Lead will remain functionally in Serving but will have a dotted-line to Marcus for cross-region projects and OKRs. We want minimal disruption to current sprint teams.

Jae (Eng Lead - Serving): I can act as interim point-of-contact for the serving team during the recruitment process. Happy to pair with Marcus on handoff docs.

Lina (Talent): Internal apply link: <https://company.internal/hiring/eng-lead-serving-l4>. Please apply by Apr 12 11:59pm PT. Panel scheduled Apr 18; targeted offer by May 2.

Marcus Vega: I'll host two 30-min office hours the week of June 5 for folks with cross-team concerns. Also will collect top-3 pain points on routing, please drop them in #eng-runtime.

Devex Bot: Calendar events created: "Marcus intro  Head of Distributed Systems" (June 2) and "Eng Lead - Serving panel" (Apr 18). Invitations sent to Serving, Runtime, SRE, and Product.

Maya (People Ops): Action items recap:
- Lina: open internal window + application link (due Apr 12)
- Marcus & Jae: prepare handoff notes and objectives (by May 20)
- Hiring panel: confirm interviewers (by Apr 14)
- People Ops: update org chart and publish dotted-line guidance (by Apr 15)

If youd like to nominate someone internally, DM Lina. Please react with :raised_hands: if you saw this.
